text:
Maya (Docs): opened a focused PR for the quota+pricing migration guide and the meter name changes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/856 — main goals: migration checklist, SDK examples, dashboard queries, and the deprecation banner.
Samir (Eng): thanks. does the guide include the exact mapping table from old metric names to new ones? e.g., `tokens_consumed` -> `inference.tokens`, `billing_amount` -> `billing.usage_usd`?
Maya (Docs): yes, there's a table in the draft. also included an SQL snippet for billing teams to reconcile historical data: `SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices WHERE metric_name = 'billing_amount'` with a note to map to `billing.usage_usd`.
Jordan (PM): add a migration checklist at the top: 1) inventory existing quota IDs, 2) map to new `quota_tier` labels (free/standard/enterprise), 3) update dashboard queries, 4) run a staging billing cycle, 5) flip deprecation banner. that'll reduce support churn.
Eli (Platform): please call out the change in quota unit: we now meter "token-minutes" for burstable routes (tokens/min). include a Grafana example to convert old `sum(tokens)` to the new rate: `sum(rate(inference.tokens[1m]))` and a quick explainer.
Ava (DevEx): we need both Node and Python examples for the new metering SDK surface. quick Node draft below — uses batch API:```js
// report batch usage
const { Client } = require('@redwood/inference');
const c = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.meter.reportBatch([
  { metric: 'inference.tokens', value: 1200, tags: { model: 'rwd-v2-small' } },
  { metric: 'requests.count', value: 3, tags: { route: '/chat' } }
]);
```
Maya (Docs): nice. i'll add a short unit test example that asserts meter names are valid strings and that `reportBatch` returns 202. Samir, can you confirm the HTTP status?
Samir (Eng): reportBatch returns 202 Accepted on success, 400 for validation errors. i'll add that note and a snippet showing error payload.
Jordan (PM): also include a rollback/backout procedure in case billing regressions appear during the 60-day deprecation window. Customers like to know how to revert quickly.
Maya (Docs): added: rollback steps -> revert client to v1 endpoint, flip dashboard queries back, and notify customers via support template.
Eli (Platform): there was a broken link in the pricing table pointing to the marketplace page. changed it in the PR to the new /pricing/reserved-capacity URL. also: change label "soft limit" -> "burstable soft limit" to clarify SLA scope.
Ava (DevEx): can we include a smoke script in examples/ that runs `meter.reportBatch` and a Grafana query against staging? i'll push a small test harness to the branch.
Samir (Eng): FYI the python SDK has a different method name: `meter.report_batch()` (snake_case). i pushed a one-line fix to the examples.
Maya (Docs): thanks — i updated both snippets. i'll also add a short migration code sample showing how to map old quota API calls to the new `quota_tier` param.
DocsBot: PR #856 updated: 5 files changed, 18 additions, 4 deletions. CI: docs-build passed.
Eli (Platform): quick review note: please include the Grafana dashboard UID in the doc so customers and SEs can import it: `uid=usage_overview_v2`.
Jordan (PM): propose 60-day deprecation with clear calendar dates and an email cadence (30d/14d/7d/1d). add support contact and rollback SLA in the doc.
Maya (Docs): done. added a deprecation banner snippet and the 60-day calendar with suggested email copy. requesting reviewers: @Samir @Eli @Ava for technical sign-off.
Samir (Eng): LGTM for metrics and SDK snippets. leaving the Grafana query wording tweak to Eli. :thumbsup:
Eli (Platform): will give final approval after I verify the dashboard UID and the "token-minutes" clarifications. aiming to approve in the next hour.
Maya (Docs): perfect — once approved i'll merge and backfill the example screenshots. thanks everyone! :rocket:
